frequency_question: How often do riparian states successfully sign a successor water-sharing treaty prior to or upon the expiration of the preceding treaty within comparable historical contexts?
membership_rule: Includes formal bilateral treaties governing shared river basins that have a fixed expiration date and historical precedent of renewal attempts. Excludes unilateral declarations, failed negotiations with no continuity, or treaties without expiration clauses.
window: 5-year window leading up to expiration date

cases.name: 1960 Indus Waters Treaty (permanent, permanent mechanism maintained)

coverage_note: 5 named; representing the primary historical instances of major transboundary water treaties reaching renewal or renegotiation milestones.
known_gaps: Excludes minor or unpublicized local watershed understandings between sub-national entities.
validity_reason: Bilateral transboundary water treaty norms and state behavior patterns change slowly over multi-decade intervals.
